entities.summary: Fuad Hasan oghlu Abdurahmanov was an Azerbaijani monumental sculptor. He received many awards, including the title of Honored Worker of Arts of the Azerbaijan SSR (1943), People's Artist of the Azerbaijan SSR (1955), becoming the first Azerbaijani to be elected a corresponding member of the Academy of Arts of the USSR (1949), and was a two-time Laureate of the State Stalin Prize.
